How Vellko Inventory Management ERP Works

Step 1: Schedule a Free Demo

See how Vellko Inventory can track your stock, scan barcodes, and sync your warehouses in a live demonstration.

Step 2: Understand Your Inventory & Warehouse Processes

We analyze your storage locations, picking routes, supplier terms, and barcode setups.

Step 3: Configure Warehouses, Products & Inventory Workflows

We configure your warehouse layout, import product catalogs, and set up automated reorder alerts.

Step 4: Import Inventory Data & Go Live

We import your active stock balances, print barcode labels, and train your team for live operations.

Dedicated Inventory Implementation Support

Transferring inventory operations to the new system is a process that requires meticulous planning.

Our implementation experts help you set up warehouses, import product data from products, create inventory workflows, and prepare your team to make the transition smooth.
